maxPoolSize.description: The maximum number of interpreters that can be in the pool. -1 means no limit

maxAgeSeconds.description: Interpreters exceeding this age are evicted from the pool on invalidation. -1 means never evict based on age.

maxTimeSinceLastUseSeconds.description:
Interpreters whose last use was greater than this many seconds ago will be evicted on invalidation.
-1 means never evict based on time since last use.

maxInterpreterMemoryMb.description:
Interpreters using more than this amount of memory are evicted from the pool on invalidation.
-1 means never evict based on memory.

maxPoolMemoryMb.description:
If the total memory used by all interpreters is greater than this threshold, evict interpreters.
-1 means never evict based on memory

policy.description: This policy dictates which interpreters are / are not pooled when the pool is saturated.
